scope: S04 source alias ledger migration and data integrity

verification.output: No whitespace errors; Git emitted LF-to-CRLF working-copy notices.

assessment: The legacy canonical-hash-only UNIQUE constraint is removed by a single SQLite transaction that copies alias IDs, paths, fingerprints, and timestamps; repeat initialization skips the rebuild. The new canonical-hash-plus-lexical unique index allows two junction aliases to share one canonical target and document ID. Upsert rejects a canonical hash already assigned to another document and a caller alias ID assigned to another alias. The fixture verifies stable store-copy relative path, source/document metadata, old hash-only null origins and first_seen_at, chunks, embedding bytes, ANN membership, queued job, foreign keys, idempotent reopen, and no raw origin paths in the public alias mapping.
tddEvidenceLimit: The author evidence records semantic RED assertions 1 and 7 before the corresponding fixes, but does not preserve raw preimplementation console transcripts or a source snapshot for independent chronology reconstruction. A stale-manifest SETUP_ERROR observed during review was excluded from RED evidence.
